==Description==
The '''Airhorn''' is a common consumable exclusively uses in [[PVP]] mode.

It can be used an unlimited number of times, but it costs {{Money|400}} to use each time. It has a 50 second cooldown, with an initial cooldown of 60.

==Usage==
Upon use, the '''Airhorn''' would add the [[Aggro]] attribute to two enemies sent by the team the player is in. These attributes would be put in a queue, meaning all the previously sent attributes needed to be applied first. It only applied it to two enemies, not two groups of enemies. For example, if nine [[Normal]]s were sent in a single group, only two of them will be [[Aggro]].

==Appearance==
The '''Airhorn''' was a white and red portable air horn with blue and gold label.
